Strategy: Add a third rewarded window between sixty and eighty to the winning band, so very loose leftovers also earn a small bonus. It may help by catching useful large leftovers, but may fail by rewarding bins that are too loose to matter.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 28 and r - item <= 42 else 0) - (25 if r - item >= 6 and r - item <= 20 else 0) + (10 if r - item >= 60 and r - item <= 80 else 0) for r in bins]
```
